bias.en: Bearish · broke the $203.6 October low, sitting on $200
bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 10月 $203.6 低点，落在 $200 关口

read.en: Coherent fell 4.9% on Nov 2 to $199.95, trading between $198.65 and $219.03. It is below the rising 5-day ($224.6), the falling 10-day ($223.1), 30-day ($270.8) and 100-day ($303.7) and the rising 200-day ($296.5) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($246.9), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: Coherent 11月2日下跌 4.9%，收于 $199.95，盘中区间 $198.65–219.03。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$224.6）、下行的 10 日（$223.1）、30 日（$270.8）和 100 日均线（$303.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$296.5）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$246.9），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The close broke the $203.6–203.9 October lows and settled on the $200 round number, so that zone is now resistance. Resistance is $203.6–203.9, then $219.0–222.6 (Nov 2 and Oct 30 highs) and $223.1–224.6 (10 and 5-day). Support is $198.65 (Nov 2 low), then $187.3–189.6 (late-December lows) and $183.6 (Dec 29 low). A close back above $204 would target $219–223; below $198.65, $187–190.
